PHYSICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electromagnetic induction? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electromagnetic induction.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electromagnetic induction.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electromagnetic induction.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Electromagnetic induction.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Thin lenses? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Thin lenses.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Thin lenses.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Thin lenses.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Thin lenses.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Floating and Sinking? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Floating and Sinking.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Floating and Sinking.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Floating and Sinking.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Floating and Sinking.

5. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. joule (J)

6. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dynamics? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dynamics.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dynamics.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dynamics.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Dynamics.

9. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Quantity of Heat? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Quantity of Heat.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Quantity of Heat.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Quantity of Heat.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Quantity of Heat.

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Electromagnetic induction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Mains electricity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Transistors and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

3. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Thin lenses.

4. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Floating and Sinking.

5. A — newton (N)

6. D — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

7. C — 100 °C

8. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dynamics.

9. A — Ice melting to water

10. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites.

11. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Quantity of Heat.

12. C — Producers
